proposed_cases.thermal_design: 初始T和全部壁温均300K；从起点以后按分段线性历史将两片相对壁分别升/降至305K/295K，其余壁300K。入口例同步给定入口温度；所有热边界按DATA完整分区。避开多迹角点的点观测。温度移位同时作用于两黏度及松弛时间。

geometry.boundary_partition: coordinate faces; split moving/thermal faces at their midpoint when specified

definitions.n: true outward unit normal of each supplied boundary entity
definitions.R: linear table (0,0),(0.1*end,1),(end,1); in steady analysis R=1
definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: absolute Pa; closed case volume mean=100000 Pa; open case fixed by full outlet traction, no extra mean constraint

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
memory_closure_constraints: Do not add conformation/stress/structure diffusion.
Supply true inflow memory; natural transport outflow; no backflow branch is included.
Conformation is SPD, 2D block with Azz=1; polymer stress is reconstructed with the DATA constitutive law.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility

definitions.C: cellwise curl of the continuous nodal P1 potential; zero potential on all boundary-adjacent elements; scale the resulting field to specified max speed. In 2D use rotated gradient of scalar potential; in 3D curl of vector potential (0,0,psi). No projection of an inconsistent initial velocity is permitted.

detailed_spec.field_time_semantics: R/P/V in an expression are evaluated once at each history node; a string time_history names interpolation only, not an extra multiplier. A dictionary of samples is an explicit scalar multiplier on the spatial expression. A constant expression with linear history has equal endpoints. Initial fields only have the start frame.
detailed_spec.field_evaluation: Expressions construct INPUT samples only. Nodal expressions are evaluated on actual nodes then interpreted as P1, entity data are actual averages of the indicated input reconstruction. Actual phase is the specified phase-cell union. Do not reinterpret sampling as an unprovided analytic field.
detailed_spec.pressure_convention: absolute Pa; closed case volume mean=100000 Pa; open case fixed by full outlet traction, no extra mean constraint

observations.primary: all quantities required by DATA; stored on the required support
observations.optional_quantities_from_grading_templat: add only applicable quantities at unique finite traces
observations.interior_node_rule: for reduced node outputs select all nodes at least two local edge layers from boundary intersections and phase/bed derivative singularities; retain the full domain-node input location separately

manufacturing_rules: All boundary entities belong to exactly one mechanical partition; independent thermal partition only when permitted by DATA.
Every numeric parameter and field uses the stated SI unit; no hidden Earth gravity or solver-specific physical input.
Output physical times are independent of native integration steps. Do not substitute a final frame for a steady state or for discrete statistics.
memory_closure_constraints: Do not add conformation/stress/structure diffusion.
Supply true inflow memory; natural transport outflow; no backflow branch is included.
Conformation is SPD, 2D block with Azz=1; polymer stress is reconstructed with the DATA constitutive law.
detailed_spec.physical_scope_status: specified; not numerically checked; no claim of solved-state admissibility
